page.title: Ol konekta
page.intro: Konektim ol edvetaismen akaun bilong yu. Ol 'lead' bilong ol edvetaismen bilong yu i save kamap long ol 'My Leads' otomatik, wantaim spend na kos bilong wanwan 'lead'.

catalog.linkedinDescription: Lead Gen Form i save go insait long My Leads, mani ol i save tromoi long olgeta de na kos bilong wan wan lead, na kwaliti bilong lead i save go bek long LinkedIn ( Conversions API ).

connect.title: Konektim LinkedIn
connect.intro: Sain insait wantaim LinkedIn akaun we i save lukautim ol edvetaismen bilong yu. Leadrat i save ritim ol edvetaismen akaun bilong yu tasol, ol lid bilong Lead Gen Form na ol edvetaismen statistiks, na salim ol konvesen yu opim.
connect.need1: Wanpela wok long LinkedIn ed akaun (Man bilong lukim o antap moa).
connect.need2: Wanpela wok long pes bilong kampani we i gat link (Edministreta, Lead Gen Forms Manager , Content Admin , Kiurata o Analis) - LinkedIn i laikim em long serim ol lida.
connect.need3: Wanpela askim long namba bilong fon long Lead Gen Forms bilong yu - ol 'lead' we i no gat fon namba i no inap long putim.

connection.fetchHint: Ol i save sekim ol nupela 'lead' long olgeta sampela minit na ol i save sekim gen las 7-pela de long olgeta de, olsem na i no gat wanpela samting i lus. Yusim dispela long ol 'lead' bilong yu pastaim long yu konektim, o long sekim wanpela taim gen (inap long 90 de long wanpela taim). Ol 'lead' we i stap pinis long Leadrat ol i lusim.

capi.title: Conversions API
capi.intro: Yu tokim LinkedIn husat bilong ol 'lead' bilong en i kamap ol 'real prospects'. Taim wanpela LinkedIn lid i kamap long wanpela status yu makim aninit, Leadrat i save ripotim i go long LinkedIn , olsem na ol ripot bilong kempen bilong yu i soim lid kwaliti na LinkedIn i ken painim moa manmeri olsem ol gutpela lid bilong yu. Ol i salim tasol LinkedIn lida ID na wanpela 'one-way hash' bilong email.
